tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search approved FirmLedger company records by name or keyword, category, country, city and verified status. Returns a short list (name, category, location, verified flag, tick, confidence score, one-line description) plus the accurate total, for picking the right company before calling get_listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: The public FirmLedger profile of one company: description, category, location, verification state (tick, how ownership was proved, when it was last checked), confidence and health scores, sources, recent moderated news headlines and the open jobs count. With FirmLedger Pro it also includes website,

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: FirmLedger Pro. The recorded relationship graph of one company: founders, investors, parent companies, subsidiaries, products, services and partners — plus the reverse edges (companies it founded or invested in). Only relationships recorded by the verified owner or moderators; nothing is inferred.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: FirmLedger Pro. Recent moderated news headlines about one company with dates, publishers and links — the same accuracy-gated stories shown on the profile's news panel.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: FirmLedger Pro. Open roles at approved FirmLedger companies, filtered by company and/or location and keyword: title, company, location, posted date and where to apply. Jobs on unapproved listings never appear.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: FirmLedger Pro. Given a website domain or URL, report whether an approved FirmLedger record uses it and return that record — useful for "is this site legit?" questions.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every FirmLedger category with its number of approved listings. Use to pick a valid category for search_listings.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The countries present in the FirmLedger directory, each with its number of approved listings.

tools.name: prepare_listing_submission
tools.description: Does NOT create anything. Returns a link to the real FirmLedger submission form with the company name, website and (optional) category, country and city pre-filled. The user opens it, signs in, completes the remaining fields, reviews everything and submits it themselves. Also reports if the company

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 approved FirmLedger companies side by side: entity type, category, location, founded, team size, website, tagline, date registered, ownership, tick, confidence and sponsored status — the same rows as the FirmLedger comparison page. Use after search_listings when the user wants to weig

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The current FirmLedger Pro offers with price, billing and duration. With an API key it also says whether this account is already on Pro and whether a free trial is available. Use before prepare_upgrade.

tools.name: list_ad_packages
tools.description: The current Sponsored-placement advertising packages with price, billing and duration. With an API key it also lists the user's own listings and which of them can be advertised or are already sponsored. Use before prepare_advertising.

tools.name: prepare_upgrade
tools.description: Does NOT charge anything. Returns a personal link to FirmLedger's own checkout for the chosen Pro plan (optionally with a promo code). The user opens it, signs in, reviews the order on FirmLedger and pays on the secure Lemon Squeezy checkout themselves. You can never complete or confirm a payment an

tools.name: prepare_advertising
tools.description: Does NOT charge anything. Checks that the listing belongs to this account and is approved, then returns a personal link to FirmLedger's own checkout for the chosen Sponsored-placement package. The user reviews and pays there themselves; you can never complete or confirm a payment. If the user says "

tools.name: get_my_listings
tools.description: The listings this account owns or submitted, with moderation status, tick, scores, Pro perks, sponsorship, jobs and new-lead counts. Use first when the user refers to "my listing".

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Audience analytics for the user's own listings — views today/7/30 days/total, unique visitors, profile and website clicks, leads, the 30-day funnel, top visitor locations and per-listing views. The same numbers as Dashboard → Audience analytics.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: The user's FirmLedger Leads inbox: inquiries received on their listings (box "received", the default), archived ones ("archived"), or inquiries they sent to other businesses ("sent"). Filter by status or listing; paginated.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.description: One conversation from the Leads inbox with the inquirer's details and every message, oldest first. Use before reply_to_lead so the reply fits the thread.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: The companies the user watches on FirmLedger, newest first.

tools.name: export_watchlist_csv
tools.description: The user's watchlist as CSV text (name, category, type, location, contact details, tech stack, verified owner, confidence, watched since) — the same file as the dashboard's Export button.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: The user's in-app FirmLedger notifications, newest first, with the unread count. Set unread_only for just the unread ones.

tools.name: list_my_tickets
tools.description: The user's FirmLedger support tickets. Pass a ticket reference to read that ticket's full conversation.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: The state of the FirmLedger REST API for this account and API key, as /api/v1/me and /api/v1/usage answer it: identity, plan and free-trial status, the key's scopes, live per-minute read/write budgets, durable usage aggregates and the endpoint catalogue. Also states plainly that the MCP connector an

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: The account's webhook destinations with events, category filters, active state and signing-secret prefix — plus recent deliveries (status, HTTP code, attempts, last error) when a webhook id is given.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: The account's API keys with label, prefix, scopes, usage totals and last use — never a raw key. Use it to name a key before revoking or re-scoping it.

tools.name: start_lead
tools.description: Start a new FirmLedger Leads conversation with another approved, claimed business. The signed-in member email is used automatically, the business email stays private, and the owner is notified in their Leads inbox. Requires the user’s confirmation of the exact inquiry.

tools.name: reply_to_lead
tools.description: Send a reply in one of the user's lead conversations, exactly as the Reply box on the website does (the other party is notified). Requires the user's confirmation: the first call returns the exact message for them to approve.

tools.name: set_lead_status
tools.description: Move a lead in the user's business inbox to new, contacted, qualified, won or lost. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Add an approved company to the user's watchlist so they are notified when its record changes. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove a company from the user's watchlist. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Open a FirmLedger support ticket for the user. Categories: billing, technical, listing, account, verification, other. Requires the user's confirmation of the exact subject and message.

tools.name: manage_job
tools.description: Manage a job owned by the member: edit its title, type, location, apply link or description, close it, or permanently remove it. Editing a live or closed role returns it to moderation before it is public again. Requires the user’s confirmation.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Submit a job opening on one of the user's listings (the listing needs active Pro perks; up to 5 open or pending roles). Like the dashboard form, it goes to moderation first and is published after approval. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one notification (notification_id) or all of them (all: true) as read. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: refresh_listing_scores
tools.description: Recompute the confidence, health and completeness scores of one of the user's listings from its current record — the dashboard's "Re-align scores". Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: refresh_listing_tech
tools.description: Scan the website of one of the user's listings and refresh its technology snapshot — the dashboard's "Refresh tech". Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: refresh_listing_news
tools.description: Look for new coverage of one of the user's approved listings with the same accuracy rules and moderation as the dashboard's "Refresh news" (once a minute per listing). Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: request_listing_removal
tools.description: Send a removal request for a listing the user owns or originally submitted. A moderator reviews it; nothing is removed until they accept. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: prepare_listing_claim
tools.description: Free. Prepare a link to claim an approved listing using DNS TXT, HTML meta tag or site badge. Creates nothing and never grants ownership. The user signs in, generates a token, installs the proof on the business domain and verifies it on FirmLedger.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook on the user’s account after explicit confirmation. Listing events will be sent to this URL. Requires Pro (including a free trial) and write:account. The signing secret is returned only once; keep it private.

tools.name: reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Send a reply in one of the user's own support tickets — the same thread the dashboard shows, and the same message an agent answers. Closed tickets cannot take replies. Requires the user's confirmation of the exact text.

tools.name: manage_webhooks
tools.description: Create, update, pause, resume, rotate the signing secret of, test, retry a delivery for, or delete a webhook destination on the user's account — the same operations as Dashboard → Developer API. Secrets come back only for create and rotate. Requires the user's confirmation.

tools.name: manage_api_keys
tools.description: Create an API key (the raw key is returned once), revoke a key, or change a key's scopes — the dashboard's Developer API controls. Requires the user's confirmation. Keys can also carry the AI-assistant scopes (read:account / write:account) that this connector uses.

tools.name: update_my_listing
tools.description: Change fields on a listing the user owns (name, tagline, description, website, email, phone, country, city, region, address, logo_url, founded, size, tags, socials) — the same service the dashboard edit form and PUT /api/v1/my/listings/:id use, including the re-moderation rule when the core record c

tools.name: manage_lead
tools.description: Archive a conversation out of the business inbox, restore it, or delete it permanently — the dashboard's conversation controls. Requires the user's confirmation (deleting is irreversible).

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Report what this FirmLedger connection can do: Free or Pro access, authentication and active free-trial status, and which tools and fields are available. Use when the user asks why something is locked.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, check_domain, list_leads, get_lead, get_notifications, list_my_tickets, create_support_ticket, post_job, mark_notifications_read · Private data: search_listings, check_domain, list_plans, list_ad_packages, prepare_upgrade, export_watchlist_csv, get_api_status, list_webhooks, list_api_keys, start_lead, watchlist_add, refresh_listing_scores, prepare_listing_claim, create_webhook, manage_webhooks, manage_api_keys, update_my_listing · Public sink: get_listing, list_webhooks, start_lead, reply_to_lead, post_job, request_listing_removal, create_webhook, reply_to_ticket, manage_webhooks, update_my_listing · Destructive: watchlist_remove, manage_job, manage_webhooks, manage_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, check_domain, list_leads, get_lead, get_notifications, list_my_tickets, create_support_ticket, post_job, mark_notifications_read · Private data: search_listings, check_domain, list_plans, list_ad_packages, prepare_upgrade, export_watchlist_csv, get_api_status, list_webhooks, list_api_keys, start_lead, watchlist_add, refresh_listing_scores, prepare_listing_claim, create_webhook, manage_webhooks, manage_api_keys, update_my_listing · Public sink: get_listing, list_webhooks, start_lead, reply_to_lead, post_job, request_listing_removal, create_webhook, reply_to_ticket, manage_webhooks, update_my_listing · Destructive: watchlist_remove, manage_job, manage_webhooks, manage_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
